text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah, aah... How could this be...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"The stream for 'Detective Colombo' has 
ended, sir...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Detective Charanbo's humor was always so 
comforting to my tired body after 
training, but now...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There's just no way we can find a 
replacement for Charanbo, sir... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by deep sorrow, Fenomeno hung 
her head, feeling terribly downcast.
